synopsis: ISO 3691-4:2023 covers driverless industrial trucks and their systems; Chapter 12 identifies it as current, with a draft international standard for Edition 3 in progress [f15281, f9783]. The glossary places it alongside neighboring-sector standards, describing its scope as driverless warehouse trucks rather than heavy off-road machines [f15276]. Chapter 12 and the glossary report that no simulation provisions were found, while a separate Chapter 12 finding reports no wording on virtual-only validation; these are review gaps, not evidence of permission for virtual-only validation [f9784, f15282, f9459]. The booklet reports revision activity in 2025–2026 and recommends allowing the validation plan to be re-baselined, while explaining that the published edition remains in force during revision [f10368, f10369, f15054]. There is an unresolved verification gap across chapters: Chapter 5 says the standard was not verified and calls for checking editions, application dates and simulation clauses before reliance, whereas Chapter 12 identifies the current edition and reports review findings [f4335, f9783, f9784].
